MainWindow.1. Apri le proprietà audio del sensore i:
1. Open the sensor audio properties in Windows.
2. Disable enhancements, noise suppression, echo cancellation and AGC.
3. Set the level without reaching the red zone.
4. Rest the watch case firmly on the sensor and do not move the cable.

ChronoLab applies its own filters to the raw signal.
